description: Search Console totals for the last 7, 30 or 90 days (default 30): totalClicks, totalImpressions, avgCtr (a share of 1, so 0.05 is 5%), avgPosition (an average over the searches you appeared in, never a rank), and trends, each day's clicks and impressions, oldest first. connected says whether Search Console is connected, and lastSyncError appears when the last update from it failed. Null, with a hint, until the Analytics screen is turned on (activate_analytics_screen) or while Search Console is not connected. Per-keyword clicks are in get_rankings.
name: get_search_console
